text:
`python3 -m unittest` now reports all 16 tests passing. I only changed code in `catalog/`, and the tests are untouched.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, so it now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` goes from 3 to 5, matching the policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies days by the daily rate instead of adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events, so the slice is now `[-n:]`.
- **`factory.py`:** I added a third sample book, `Emma` by Austen (1815, 1 copy). The tests and docstring only fix the title. I made up the author, year and copy count.
